Payment processor Dwolla cut off TradeHill (early US Bitcoin exchange) citing compliance/FinCEN pressure, freezing funds and killing the exchange (TradeHill later sued Dwolla). Early financial-rail debanking of a crypto exchange. tier=discovery_only_2008_2012. AUTHORED as events/tradehill-dwolla-payment-cutoff-2012-02.yaml (tick 3).

CFPB consumer advisory warning about virtual-currency risks. BORDERLINE SCOPE: a warning/advisory, not a block or enforcement action — review whether soft regulatory-posture markers belong in the censorship census (likely a null/context row at best).

Cryptsy exchange collapse/insolvency (CEO "Big Vern" allegedly stole millions; court receiver). LIKELY OUT OF SCOPE: a fraud/theft/insolvency, NOT a censorship action — flagging for scope decision (exchange failures != censorship unless state-driven).

IOSCO 18 policy recommendations for crypto/digital-asset markets. SOFT-GOVERNANCE (recommendations, not a block) -> likely context-only per scope-boundary question.
